preconditions.expression: 1 <= ai < bi <= n and 1 <= ci <= m
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices and has a unique color.

preconditions.expression: not exists (ai, bi, ci), (aj, bj, cj) where ai < aj < bi and bi < bj and ci == cj
preconditions.description: There are no multiple edges of the same color between two vertices.
The vertices in each query are distinct.

postconditions.description: The number of answers matches the number of queries.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= answer[i] <= m for i in range(q))
postconditions.description: Each answer is a non-negative integer within the range of available colors.

postconditions.expression: all(answer[i] == count_colors_connecting(ui, vi) for i in range(q))
postconditions.description: Each answer is the count of colors that connect the given vertices ui and vi directly or indirectly.
